questions.question: Your background includes SAP-based bank and financial-account reconciliations at Blue Ridge Healthcare System. Which SAP version and finance modules did you use, and how have you used SAP to create, review, or post general-ledger journal entries?
Walk us through a month-end close you managed, including how you established cut-off, prepared or reviewed journal entries, resolved reconciling items, and kept the close on schedule.

This role requires payroll and cost accruals. Describe how you have reconciled corporate payroll and tax activities, and explain how you would calculate and validate a payroll accrual when final payroll data is not yet available at month-end.

You have developed accounting policies and business-process documentation to strengthen internal controls. Tell us about one control improvement you implemented, the risk it addressed, and how you determined whether it reduced errors or improved compliance.

The role involves maintaining the chart of accounts and cost-center reporting. If a department requested a new cost center or account that could overlap with an existing one, how would you assess the request and protect reporting consistency?

Your experience includes analyzing budgets, revenues, and expenditure trends and advising management on forecasting. Give an example of an analysis that identified a meaningful variance or trend, the drivers you investigated, and how your recommendation influenced a management decision.
How would you build a cross-margin profitability analysis for a project or business area when revenue, direct costs, shared overhead, and timing differences are recorded across several cost centers?

You list GAAP accounting practices and tax-return preparation. What experience do you have applying US GAAP to complex accounting judgments, and what exposure, if any, have you had to IFRS accounting?

Describe the most advanced Excel analyses or reporting tools you have used in accounting or financial reporting. How would you use Excel and PowerPoint to communicate a month-end result or profitability issue clearly to non-finance stakeholders?

This position works in an international and cross-cultural environment. Drawing on your cross-functional work with auditors, payroll stakeholders, or HR teams, how would you adapt your communication and coordinate close activities with colleagues in different locations or working styles?
